question: What should one make in solitude while intent on meditation?
premises: bahudhā rūpaṃ kuru commands making form in many ways
dhyānañ ca tatparaḥ adds meditation and intent
inference: In solitude one should make form in many ways, intent on meditation.
uncertainties: exact meditative technique is not specified
plain_english: In solitude, make form in many ways, intent on meditation.
